method: source pointer; GET (no auth) of the JSON endpoint behind VoteWA's online voter guide page for Pierce County, cached locally (gitignored) at cache_file
how_found: GenericVoterGuide.aspx?e=899&c=27 embeds <votewa-vg api="https://voter.votewa.gov/elections" e="899" c="27" p="XX" la="en">; Scripts/votewa-vg.js loads {api}/voterguide.ashx?e&la&c&p, {api}/measure.ashx?m&e&la&c and {api}/candidate.ashx?e&r&b&la&c.
contents: Election GENERAL 2026 (899), Pierce County: 17 measures (3 statewide, 14 Pierce local: RaceIDs 7313-7319 county charter amendments 52-58, 7310 City of Milton Prop 1, 7311 Town of South Prairie Prop 1, 7308 Pierce Transit Prop 1, 7309 City of Tacoma Initiative 1, 7312 Fire Protection District No. 14 Prop 1, 7259 Auburn School District No. 408 Prop 1, 7370 Yelm Community Schools Prop 1) and every candidate race on the Pierce general ballot (same candidate names as the VoteWA candidate-list export).
notes: Candidate statements: candidate.ashx returns each candidate's statement in the "Statement" field (CandidateStatementText is empty and IsApprovedForPost is False on 2026-10-08); copies are in raw/votewa/candidate-statements/race-<RaceID>.json. Every Pierce general candidate has one except Kerry Hills (LD 28 Pos. 2). Measure ballot titles, explanatory statements and pro/con statements are posted (measure.ashx; verbatim copies under raw/measures/<slug>/). Pierce County's own site (piercecountywa.gov, local voters' pamphlet) answers this environment with a Cloudflare challenge (HTTP 403).
